_comment: Synthetic fixture, documented shape (KI-17 layer 2). Not captured from a real machine: this repo's `tailscale serve status --json` currently returns `{}` (nothing configured). Hostname is a synthetic placeholder, not a real tailnet name. This is the actual KI-17 scenario: a public mapping (here, tailnet's own public port 8443) forwards straight to port 8787 -- the loopback listener 'local' holds, admin and EXECUTE included -- rather than to this transport's own dedicated local port (8788). Preflight must refuse regardless of which public port carries the mapping.
